The hatchback is powered by a 5.0-liter V8 paired with a BorgWarner T-5 five-speed manual transmission and a Traction-Lok limited-slip differential. Equipment includes a lowered suspension, a rear spoiler, revised bumper covers and side skirts, white 16″ wheels, four-wheel disc brakes, a Hurst quick-ratio shifter, a roll bar, FloFit adjustable bucket seats, cruise control, and power windows. This Fox-body Mustang shows 2470 miles.

The hatchback body was modified by Saleen with a revised front air dam, side skirts, rear hatch spoiler, and rear valance. All were finished in Oxford White (9L) with gray moldings, black and yellow graphics, and a Saleen decal on the windshield.

The 16″ DP5 SCC alloy wheels are standard equipment and also includes a Handling Suspension Package featuring variable-rate springs and a Quadra-Shock rear setup along with power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering. The suspension has been lowered on this example, and replacement shocks are fitted. The removed shocks are included in the sale. Braking is handled by power-assisted front discs and rear discs.

The cabin features FloFit adjustable bucket seats upholstered in gray and white leather with yellow piping and mesh headrests, which are accompanied by a color-coordinated dashboard, door panels, and carpets. Amenities include a Hurst shifter, cruise control, a Pioneer cassette stereo, a “stylistic” four-point roll bar, and power windows and locks.

The Saleen-tuned electronically-fuel-injected 5.0-liter V8 features a 65mm throttle body, larger cylinder head ports, and high-flow catalytic converters. Output was rated at 292 horsepower and 325 lb-ft of torque, and has been further modified with a period correct Vortec Supercharger.

This 2003 BMW X5 4.4i is a great example of BMWs original sport luxury SUV, powered by the desirable 4.4L V8 engine. The E53 X5 has aged into a modern classic, offering a solid, planted driving feel, upscale interior comfort, and true BMW performance in an SUV package.

The 4.4L V8 delivers strong power, smooth acceleration, and a refined exhaust note that makes this X5 feel much more special than the average SUV. Paired with BMWs all-wheel-drive system, it offers confident traction and a comfortable ride whether youre cruising around town or heading out on the highway.

Inside, the X5 gives you the classic early-2000s BMW feel with a driver-focused layout, quality materials, supportive seating, and great visibility. These first-generation X5s are becoming harder to find in nice condition, especially with the V8.
All 4 tires have plenty of tread, and the truck drives smooth.
